# FG-AUTH-0017

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `logout_token_failures_are_logout_token_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ログアウトの通知を受け付けられませんでした。
- en: The logout notification was not accepted.
- id: Pemberitahuan keluar tidak diterima.

## 原因 (cause)

`POST /-/auth/backchannel-logout` (OIDC Back-Channel Logout, ADR-0021 §8, M2 MR5) received a logout token that failed verification: not a form body with one `logout_token` of at most 64 KiB; its signature, algorithm or key (the ID token's rules, ADR-0021 §9); `iss` (not `auth.oidc.issuer`); `aud` (without the client id); `iat` (missing, more than 60 s in the future or more than 2 minutes old); `exp` (when present, passed beyond the 60 s skew); `events` without `http://schemas.openid.net/event/backchannel-logout`; neither `sid` nor `sub`; a `nonce` (a logout token never has one); no `jti`; or a `jti` already accepted in the last 10 minutes (a replay). No session was revoked. The caller is the identity provider's server, never a browser: a person never sees this message.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.backchannel_logout_failed` carries `reason`: body (with `detail`: content_type, too_large, form, token_missing), malformed, alg_not_allowed, kid_missing, unknown_kid, key_invalid, key_alg_mismatch, signature, issuer, audience, expired, not_yet_valid, too_old (iat older than 2 minutes: a delayed delivery or a replay), missing_claim (with `claim`: iat, jti, events, sid_or_sub), events, nonce_present, replayed (the jti was seen), replay_table_full (more than 10 000 logouts within 10 minutes). The token itself is never logged. A burst of signature / issuer from one peer is someone probing the endpoint; replayed right after a Keycloak restart can be Keycloak re-sending a delivered logout (harmless: the sessions were revoked the first time); too_old in numbers points at a clock skew (`forge doctor` reports it) or a queue at the identity provider.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook oidc-login: check that the realm's client `gitstation` sends back-channel logouts to `web.base_url` + `/-/auth/backchannel-logout` with "Backchannel logout session required" on, that `auth.oidc.issuer` and the client id match the realm, and the clocks of both servers (`forge doctor`). Probing from elsewhere needs no fix: the endpoint revokes nothing without a valid signed token; block the peer at the network if it persists.
